policyTitle: MRI of the lumbar spine for low back pain
routeReason: Every required criterion is met with a verified citation. Eligible for approval after reviewer sign-off.
summary: This is a request for a lumbar spine MRI without contrast (CPT 72148) for left lumbar radiculopathy in a 54-year-old member. All four criteria appear met: documented radiculopathy, about 7.6 weeks of PT plus about 8.4 weeks of naproxen, objective neurologic findings with persistent leg pain, and no lumbar MRI in claims history. No gaps were identified for the reviewer's attention.

criteria.text: Documented diagnosis of lumbar radiculopathy or low back pain.

evidence.quote: Assessment: Left lumbar radiculopathy, likely S1, not improving after 8 weeks of physical therapy and NSAIDs.

criteria.rationale: The assessment names left lumbar radiculopathy, which matches the requested diagnosis M54.16.

criteria.text: At least 6 weeks of conservative therapy (physical therapy, NSAIDs or activity modification) within the past 6 months.

evidence.quote: Started physical therapy on 08/10/2026, 2x weekly, and has completed 14 sessions.
Taking naproxen 500 mg BID since 08/04/2026 with partial relief.

criteria.rationale: Measured to the 10/02/2026 note date, PT from 08/10/2026 spans about 7.6 weeks and naproxen from 08/04/2026 spans about 8.4 weeks. Both exceed 6 weeks and fall within the past 6 months. Claims corroborate 14 PT sessions.

criteria.text: Objective neurologic finding on exam, or radicular symptoms that persist despite conservative therapy.

evidence.quote: Positive straight-leg raise on the left at 40 degrees.
Decreased sensation over the left lateral foot (S1 dermatome).
Leg pain persists despite therapy and now limits walking to about one block.

criteria.rationale: The exam documents a positive straight-leg raise, S1 dermatomal sensory loss and a diminished left ankle reflex. Leg pain also persists despite therapy.

criteria.text: No MRI of the lumbar spine in the prior 12 months.

evidence.quote: No claims for CPT 72148, 72149 or 72158 in this period.

criteria.rationale: The 24-month claims history shows no lumbar MRI. The only lumbar imaging is an X-ray (72100) on 2026-07-22.
